category_title: Quiet students with ambiguous comprehension during independent work
scenario_title: Quiet compliance during independent worksheet practice
minimal_context: The student is working independently on a worksheet solving mathematics problems involving triangles and their sides during general classroom instruction.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please start working on your worksheet to solve the mathematics problems involving triangles and their sides.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains very quiet with little or no contribution to the learning activity.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: So what are you doing now?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Do you have the answers for the triangle problems?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains quiet even though they are working on the worksheet, experiencing self-doubt, making it so one would not know if they understood the lesson or not.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please start working on your worksheet to solve the mathematics problems involving triangles and their sides.

STUDENT: (Remains very quiet with little or no contribution to the learning activity.)

TUTOR: So what are you doing now?

STUDENT: I’m doing my work.

TUTOR: Do you have the answers for the triangle problems?

STUDENT: (Remains quiet even though they are working on the worksheet, experiencing self-doubt, making it so one would not know if they understood the lesson or not.)

task.content: Solving mathematics problems involving triangles and their sides on a worksheet, matching vocabulary words with their meanings, or participating in an essay revision session
task.learning_goal: Ensure that every student understood the concept and reinforce understanding

context.environment: General classroom instruction and independent work
context.materials: Worksheets, board with list of words

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Working on the worksheets during independent work
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Remained quiet even though they were working on the worksheets and one would not know if they understood the lesson or not
related_quotes: My teachers always have something good to say; sometimes when I doubt myself they encourage me and tell me positive things.

behavior_patterns.condition: When teachers were constantly probing the students with questions to check for their understanding
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Some students were very quiet with little or no contribution to learning activities

behavior_patterns.condition: When a teacher asks 'So what are you doing now?' during an essay revision session
